cases.title: Access Web Location Dialog via Menubar and Keyboard
cases.description: Verify that the web location dialog can be successfully accessed using both the application menubar option and the keyboard shortcut, ensuring proper focus and dialog display.

cases.title: Open Web Location in Current Navigator Window
cases.description: Verify that entering a valid URL and submitting it opens the web location in the current Navigator window and properly dismisses the dialog.

cases.title: Open Web Location in New Navigator Window
cases.description: Verify that entering a valid URL and selecting the new window option opens the web location in a new Navigator window and dismisses the dialog.

cases.title: Open Web Location in Composer Window
cases.description: Verify that a web location can be opened within a Composer window from the dialog, and that the dialog is dismissed upon confirmation.

cases.title: Error Handling for Nonexistent Web Location
cases.description: Verify that an appropriate error message is displayed when attempting to open a nonexistent or bogus web location URL.

cases.title: Open Local Files in Current Navigator Window
cases.description: Verify that valid local HTML and plain text files can be opened in the current Navigator window, and that the dialog is dismissed.

cases.title: Open Local Files in New Navigator Window
cases.description: Verify that valid local HTML and plain text files can be opened in a new Navigator window, with proper dismissal of the dialog.

cases.title: Open Local Files in Composer Window
cases.description: Verify that local HTML and plain text files can be successfully opened in a Composer window and that the web location dialog closes.

cases.title: Error Handling for Nonexistent Local File
cases.description: Verify that an error message is displayed when attempting to open a nonexistent local file path.

analysis.analysis: R-166: Testable behavior includes opening the web location dialog via menubar and designated keyboard shortcut. Boundaries involve focus states and menu navigation. Normal path: trigger via menubar/shortcut and verify dialog opens. Abnormal path: attempt trigger while application is busy or menus are disabled. Ambiguity: specific keyboard shortcut is not defined. R-167: Testable behavior is entering a valid URL and opening it in the current Navigator window, plus dismissing the dialog. Boundaries: empty URL, valid HTTP/HTTPS URLs. Normal path: input valid URL, select current window action, confirm, verify loading and dialog dismissal. Abnormal path: submit empty string or invalid syntax. Ambiguity: behavior of malformed URLs without protocol. R-168: Testable behavior is opening a URL in a new Navigator window and dismissing the dialog. Boundaries: single vs multiple new windows. Normal path: input URL, select new window action, confirm, verify new window creation and dialog closure. Abnormal path: popup blocker interference if applicable. Ambiguity: window focus behavior after opening. R-169: Testable behavior is opening a web location in a Composer window with dialog dismissal. Boundaries: existing vs new Composer instance. Normal path: input URL, select Composer action, confirm, verify content loads in Composer and dialog closes. Abnormal path: Composer module unavailable or failing. Ambiguity: editing permissions of loaded URL in Composer. R-170: Testable behavior is displaying an error when a nonexistent URL is entered. Boundaries: DNS failure, HTTP 404, unreachable host. Normal path: enter bogus URL, confirm, verify error message is displayed. Abnormal path: timeout delays before error display. Ambiguity: exact text or UI component used for error notification. R-171: Testable behavior is opening local HTML and plain text files in the current Navigator window with dialog dismissal. Boundaries: file path formats, file extensions (.html, .txt). Normal path: provide valid local file path, select current window, verify file content renders and dialog closes. Abnormal path: permission denied on local file. Ambiguity: handling of plain text rendering (wrapping/formatting). R-172: Testable behavior is opening local HTML and plain text files in a new Navigator window with dialog dismissal. Boundaries: file paths, multiple files. Normal path: provide local file path, select new window, verify new window renders file and dialog closes. Abnormal path: missing local file. Ambiguity: default window size for new window. R-173: Testable behavior is opening local HTML and plain text files in a Composer window with dialog dismissal. Boundaries: file formats (.html, .txt). Normal path: provide local file path, select Composer, verify file opens in Composer and dialog closes. Abnormal path: file locked by another process. Ambiguity: whether text files open as source or rendered. R-174: Testable behavior is displaying an error when a nonexistent local file is provided. Boundaries: invalid path strings, non-existent directories. Normal path: input bogus local path, confirm, verify error message is shown. Abnormal path: malformed path syntax causing application crash instead of handled error. Ambiguity: specific error message for missing files versus permission errors.
